nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the production Next.js 16 image: installs dependencies with a frozen pnpm lockfile, builds the standalone output with the public NEXT_PUBLIC_* build args, then ships a minimal Alpine runtime that runs as a non-root user on port 3000.
nodes.languageNotes: Four stages (base/deps/builder/runner) built around Next's `output: "standalone"`, so the final image only carries traced runtime deps and server.js rather than the build toolchain or full node_modules.

nodes.name: base
nodes.summary: Base stage: node:22-alpine with libc6-compat installed (for native deps expecting glibc symbols on musl) and Corepack enabled for pnpm; every later stage builds from it.

nodes.name: deps
nodes.summary: Installs dependencies with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` from only the lockfile-affecting files (package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm-workspace.yaml), so this layer caches across source-only changes.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: Copies node_modules from deps plus the full source, injects NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY as build ARGs (Next inlines NEXT_PUBLIC_* vars into the client bundle at build time, not at container start), and runs `pnpm build`.

nodes.name: runner
nodes.summary: Minimal runtime stage: creates an unprivileged nextjs user, copies public/ and the traced standalone server plus static assets from builder, and runs `node server.js` on port 3000.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Build-context exclusions for the Docker image: strips node_modules, build output, VCS/CI/editor files, local tooling/docs, and every .env* secret except .env.example, so none of it is baked into an image layer.
